name: Skybreak Online
storyline: In Veyloria, a shattered sky hangs over a world struggling with hunger. Two nations seek different answers to the same crisis. Aurelan follows Seyra and hopes to restore the old order by repairing the broken sky, while Varkhai follows Kaldur and seeks a solution through dark power. Between them stands Duravel, a neutral city where members of both nations gather to trade and prepare for their journeys. Players choose a nation and take their place in the conflict between Aurelan and Varkhai.
summary: Skybreak Online is a free-to-play MMORPG made in Türkiye. Players join one of two nations and pick one of five classes, each with two paths. The nations fight each other in large battles. Weapons and armor are upgraded at the anvil, and at high levels the item can break. Upgraded gear glows, so strong players stand out in a crowd. Players can form clans with a shared treasury and clan wars.
